findings: Complete current MDX SHA-256 is 18e4fc9f50c00853dab20df95954329e28825c32871abe53bd846acb6c9024e6; all 4 declared sources passed current HTTPS access review.

The controlled Upton plan is 7,275,413 bytes, SHA-256 216ea3d58ddc8117385a8c8338250460d39bcc91020f2306affeaf59cd071daf, and 94 visually reviewed physical pages; the relevant claim set is limited to physical pages 21 through 24.

The article preserves the plan statements about source categories, annual discounted-cash-flow calibration tests, multiple individual reviews, taxpayer and protest review opportunities, and the stated Comptroller performance test as source attribution.
The current Comptroller layer separates SDPVS from ADRS and prevents the plan PVS label from being expanded into a current Upton finding.
No source category is claimed to have been used for a particular account, and section order is not presented as proof of chronological account execution.

sources_inspected.label: Upton CAD 2025-2026 Reappraisal Plan (accessed 2026-08-31)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: The official scanned Upton CAD plan supplies the document-section statements for source categories, calibration, individual review, and the stated performance test on physical pages 21 through 24.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: The article treats section order as a source-reading map, not an account audit, chronological proof, validation of a source, valuation recommendation, protest strategy, or property-specific result.

sources_inspected.label: Upton County Appraisal District Data and Records (accessed 2026-08-31)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: The Upton CAD Data and Records page supplies the official publisher route and visible 2025-and-2026 reappraisal-plan link.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: The route establishes provenance only and does not prove current application, account treatment, ownership, appraisal correctness, tax, title, private value, or a transaction result.

sources_inspected.label: Texas Comptroller Property Tax Assistance About Us (accessed 2026-08-31)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: The current Texas Comptroller page distinguishes the School District Property Value Study from the Appraisal District Ratio Study and states their different purposes.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: The page does not validate the Upton plan, prove a current Upton result, audit an account, or determine appraisal, tax, title, private value, an offer, or a transaction result.

sources_inspected.label: Texas Comptroller Property Tax Data Reports and Surveys (accessed 2026-08-31)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: The current Texas Comptroller reports page describes ADRS purpose and published measures, including median level and coefficient of dispersion.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: The article uses that page only to prevent PVS, SDPVS, and ADRS from being collapsed into one label and does not infer a current Upton study finding.
